notes: After the English extraction fix that recovered 2MA ch7 v10-42 + ch8 v3-36 from study-note contamination, 2 Maccabees aligns very cleanly: only 3 of 15 chapters diverge, each by exactly +1 ar verse where Vulgate split a single LXX verse into two for narrative clarity.
ch2 v32-33 split — narrator's transition from preface to main narrative.
ch12 v45-46 split — Judas's offering for the dead and theological reasoning. (This is the locus classicus for Catholic doctrine on prayers for the dead, hence Vulgate's emphasis-driven split.)
